fusions.name: Felling Stroke
fusions.desc: A finishing chop that deals 26 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Woodsman's Arc
fusions.desc: A flat, economical swing that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you.

fusions.name: Edge Discipline
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Splitting Habit
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
